title: Constraint: Adjacent Cells Differ
constraints: Each cell of the 4 × 4 grid holds a color 0 … 3. Horizontally and vertically **adjacent** cells must have different colors (a proper grid coloring).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Two neighbour constraints per cell, guarded at the grid edge.
`foreach (grid[i, j])` visits every cell with both indices.
